methodology.description: Chromium headless, software WebGL and loopback production build; mobile is viewport/touch emulation, not a physical device.
methodology.ready: Wall time from navigation to the game ready signal in a fresh browser context; no network or CPU throttling.
methodology.shot: Rack seed 42, default cue placement and aim 0 degrees, power 75%; actual game controls and simulation. Six-second requestAnimationFrame intervals are classified by game phase at each callback.
methodology.frameSampling: An interval on a phase transition can partly belong to the previous phase. Frame pacing is not GPU time; the game renders only when needed.
methodology.drawCalls: Not sampled in this quality-only mode.
methodology.lifecycle: Not sampled in this quality-only mode.
limitations: SwiftShader, headless execution, OS file cache and unthrottled loopback are not a hardware GPU or realistic mobile network.
Emulation does not establish physical iOS/Android performance, browser chrome, battery or thermal behavior.
Draw counts and frame intervals do not measure GPU time, shader stalls, texture allocation or total device memory.
Six lifecycle cycles and JS heap/DOM/listener snapshots do not prove the absence of sustained leaks, including GPU leaks.
methodology.quality: Open App options, select Graphics quality: Performance, close the dialog, then measure a real shot at 390x844 / DPR 3.
